content.value: Life regeneration is calculated per second as flat regeneration + maximum health x percent regeneration. It is applied continuously in twentieths each tick. Regeneration Rate While Moving multiplies it while horizontal movement is detected. Natural hunger regeneration is disabled.

Physical Damage Leeched as Life takes a portion of final physical hit damage and scales it by increased life leech. A single hit cannot create more than 10% of maximum health as leech. Leech is then recovered over time by the leech manager.

Intelligence grants +2 maximum mana per point and each character level grants +4. Mana regeneration restores maximum mana x Mana Regeneration Percent per second, multiplied by Mana Regeneration Rate, Mana Recovery Rate, and movement recovery where applicable.

Physical Damage Leeched as Mana is immediate, scales with increased mana leech and Mana Recovery Rate, and is capped to 10% of maximum mana per hit. Health on Kill, percent health on kill, and Mana on Kill trigger when the build receives kill credit.

Vaal Pact disables life regeneration. Zealot's Oath sends life regeneration to Energy Shield. Ghost Reaver disables normal Energy Shield recharge. These keystones require a deliberate alternate recovery plan.
